titulo: How to fix a squeaky door in thirty seconds

frases.texto: How do you fix a squeaky door in thirty seconds?
That squeak is a dry pin, grinding metal on metal inside the hinge.
Close the door, and pull just one pin. All of them, and the door drops.
Tap it up from underneath with a nail. If it sticks, lift the handle and slide it out.
Wipe the grit off, and coat the pin with petroleum jelly.
Push it back down, wipe the extra, and swing the door.
Skip the cooking oil. It runs, and then it turns sticky.
Still noisy? Tighten the screws. A warped frame needs a carpenter.
Send this to that friend whose door squeaks every morning.
